Own apps/web. Regenerate contracts with uv run python scripts/generate-types.py. Use presentation timestamps and exact display aspect ratio; keep missing/interpolated points distinct. No decorative controls or fake hosted uploads. Run npm ci --prefix apps/web and npm run build --prefix apps/web, then browser-check playback, frame step, event editing, calibration, exports and responsive focus states.
